notes: Tickets can now have file attachments, both when creating and replying. Nuemeta Actions moved to a per-track button, plus a real Spotify Profile editor in Moderation. Fixed drafts piling up as separate copies, a support-email list-formatting bug, and "Past cases" always showing 0. Hardened the local database against corruption from a force-quit. Added a "Create tickets from new mail" setting, off by default, to prevent duplicate tickets when more than one installation is open at once.
mac_notes: Tickets can now have file attachments, both when creating and replying. Nuemeta Actions moved to a per-track button, plus a real Spotify Profile editor in Moderation. Fixed drafts piling up as separate copies, a support-email list-formatting bug, and "Past cases" always showing 0. Hardened the local database against corruption from a force-quit. Added a "Create tickets from new mail" setting, off by default, to prevent duplicate tickets when more than one installation is open at once.
windows_notes: Tickets can now have file attachments, both when creating a new ticket and when replying to one - this also fixes Create Ticket only recording a ticket internally without actually emailing the person it was addressed to. Fixed the Nuemeta menu on a track in Moderation getting cut off at the bottom of the list instead of showing all its options. Fixed a customer's past ticket history always showing as empty in Tickets' user panel, even when they had real closed tickets on file.
